records.label: spacr.install_cleanup.apply_optional_cleanup#1
records.source: Only a trusted Python context-manager factory can enable execution. The application's caller must hold its established run-registration lock and refuse active work throughout the context. This is an application-local safeguard, not proof that every other process is idle. A separate helper or saved dictionary cannot grant that authority.
records.context: Only a trusted Python context-manager factory can enable execution. The application's caller must hold its established run-registration lock and refuse active work throughout the context. This is an application-local safeguard, not proof that every other process is idle. A separate helper or saved key-value mapping cannot grant that authority.
records.translation: Aðeins traust Python-fall sem býr til samhengisstjóra getur heimilað keyrslu. Kallandi hluti forritsins verður að halda fyrirliggjandi læsingu fyrir skráningu keyrslna og hafna virkri vinnu allan tímann sem samhengið er opið. Þetta er vernd innan forritsins, ekki sönnun þess að allir aðrir ferlar séu óvirkir. Aðskilið hjálparforrit eða vistuð vörpun lykla á gildi getur ekki veitt þá heimild.

records.source: Recognized cache contents are inspected only under the default spaCR home. This does not establish that every other application instance is idle.

records.translation: Innihald þekktra skyndiminna er aðeins skoðað undir sjálfgefinni heimamöppu spaCR. Einnig má lesa stærðartakmarkaða flutningsskrá úr stilltri heimamöppu spaCR til að sýna varðveittar ytri slóðir. records.label: spacr.install_cleanup.start_update_helper#12
records.source: A frozen macOS bundle in a user-writable location uses its verified DMG replacement adapter and retains its complete prior bundle. A protocol-marked Debian bundle uses graphical administrator authorization and a root-owned helper outside the installation. Both the replacement and rollback package require published checksums; package and unprivileged runtime verification precede relaunch. Unsupported frozen application families return an error before removing anything; no online-installer fallback is enabled for them.
records.context: A frozen macOS bundle in a user-writable location uses its verified DMG replacement adapter and retains its complete prior bundle. A protocol-marked Debian bundle uses graphical administrator authorization and a root-owned helper outside the installation. Both the replacement and rollback package require published checksums; package and unprivileged runtime verification precede relaunch. Unsupported frozen application families return an error before removing anything; no online-installer fallback is enabled for them.
records.translation: Frystur macOS-forritspakki á stað þar sem notandinn hefur skrifheimild notar sannreynt millistykki sitt fyrir skipti með DMG og varðveitir allan fyrri pakkann. Debian-pakki með samskiptareglumerkingu notar myndræna stjórnandaheimild og hjálparbúnað í eigu root utan uppsetningarinnar. Bæði pakkinn sem kemur í staðinn og pakkinn fyrir afturköllun krefjast birtra gátsumma; pakkinn og keyrsluumhverfið án aukinna réttinda eru sannreynd áður en forritið er ræst aftur. Óstuddar gerðir frystra forrita skila villu áður en nokkuð er fjarlægt; engin varaleið með netuppsetningarforriti er virk fyrir þær.
